resolution.note: networkFailure matches gh's 'error connecting to' stderr (verbatim capture test/fixtures/gh/gh-error-connecting.stderr.log); backoff 1 s doubling; regression test red before, green after.

title: Ship retries gh calls that cannot connect to the API
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-16 shipping #1188: `krn pr ship` exited 70 twice on gh stderr "error connecting to api.github.com" (curl to the API answered 200 at the same time); #1182's retry patterns did not cover it and its 200 ms backoff is shorter than such a blip.
Outcome: ship retries idempotent gh calls on gh's "error connecting to" failure with a 1 s doubling backoff.
Proof: a ship test whose fake gh fails pr view twice with the verbatim captured stderr then merges.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, test/ci/ship.test.ts, test/fixtures/gh/
